name: sealmetrics
description: Privacy-first, cookieless web analytics in Claude. Register a free Sealmetrics site from the chat, place the tracker, and query your traffic & conversions — no terminal needed.
long_description:
Sealmetrics is GDPR-compliant, cookieless analytics. This Desktop Extension lets Claude:

- **Register a new free site from the chat** (no account or terminal required): `provision_site` creates the account, returns the tracker snippet to paste in your site's `<head>`, and emails you a claim link to set a password.
- **Verify the install** (`verify_setup`) and **instrument events** with the canonical taxonomy + privacy rules (`get_instrumentation_guide`, `verify_event_instrumented`).
- **Query your analytics** through ~52 read-only tools (traffic, pages, conversions, audience, channels, funnels, bots, and more) once an api_key is available.

Leave the API key empty to register a new site from the chat; paste an existing read-only api_key to query data immediately. The api_key is read-only and scoped to your account.

tools.name: provision_site
tools.description: Register a NEW free Sealmetrics site from the chat (write). Returns the snippet to place; emails a claim link.

tools.name: verify_setup
tools.description: Poll until the pixel is confirmed installed (read-only).

tools.name: get_setup_status
tools.description: Report whether a site is provisioned and its pixel verified (read-only).

tools.name: detect_framework
tools.description: Best-effort detect the project framework/CMS to place the snippet (read-only).

tools.name: get_instrumentation_guide
tools.description: Canonical event-instrumentation guide with your account_id (read-only).

tools.name: verify_event_instrumented
tools.description: Confirm a conv()/micro() event reached the backend; validate taxonomy + reject PII (read-only).

tools.name: plan_install
tools.description: Validate an install plan before writing code: taxonomy, PII, revenue type, pageview mode, domains, payload size; returns a plan_id to approve (read-only).

tools.name: simulate_install
tools.description: Run the planned tracker calls in a local sandbox, or drive your dev server in a local browser, and check what pixel-service would store or reject; simulated, not verified. Executes the given calls locally, so it asks before running.

tools.name: get_marketing_playbook
tools.description: Return the step-by-step method to analyze marketing performance; auto-invoked for marketing/weekly/channel reports, then orchestrates the read-only data tools (read-only).

api_key.title: Sealmetrics API key (optional)
api_key.description: Leave EMPTY to register a new site from the chat (the read-only tools turn on automatically after you provision). Paste an existing read-only api_key to query your data immediately. Find it in your welcome email or at Settings > API Tokens.

base_url.title: API base URL (advanced)
base_url.description: Sealmetrics API base URL. Leave the default unless instructed otherwise.
